name: Providence Cedars-Sinai Tarzana Volunteer Program (16 and up)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital in four-hour shifts, at least once a week. The Emergency Department is only for volunteers 19 or older.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 16. People of all backgrounds and abilities are welcome.
duration: At least six months or 100 hours, and at least four hours a week
deadline_text: The hospital stopped taking new applications on Aug 24, 2026. No reopening date is posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: When it reopens, fill out the short online application. You then get the full application by email, have a talk with staff, get health clearance and go to orientation. Questions: 818-708-5176.
notes: You need a TB test each year, a COVID-19 vaccine and a booster. The steps take about 5 to 6 weeks.
